## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Automated CI checks pass.
- [ ] Functional behavior was tested for the affected flow.

## UX gate — required for visible changes

- [ ] Desktop layout reviewed.
- [ ] Mobile/responsive layout reviewed.
- [ ] Spacing, hierarchy, labels, inputs and buttons are visually integrated.
- [ ] Loading, empty, success, validation and error states were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Keyboard/focus behavior is acceptable for interactive controls.
- [ ] No overflow, clipped content or raw/unformatted browser controls are visible.
- [ ] EN/ES visible copy is consistent where the screen is bilingual.
- [ ] Actions use product/user language rather than implementation language.
- [ ] If this PR has no visible UI impact, this section is marked N/A in the PR description with a reason.

## Public-copy gate — always required

- [ ] No roadmap/phase labels are visible in the product (`Phase 6B`, `Fase 6B`, etc.).
- [ ] No PR/issue references are visible in the product.
- [ ] No WIP/TODO/FIXME/debug/test/internal-development copy is visible in the product.
- [ ] Explanations intended for developers are kept in PRs, issues, docs or code comments, not user-facing UI.

See `docs/DEVELOPMENT-QUALITY-GATES.md` / `docs/DEVELOPMENT-QUALITY-GATES.es.md`.
